text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock E, B, and D after sizable gains, but a gain alone is not a reason to exit; I should judge each holding by its future prospects and role in the portfolio.","Treating each stock as a separate account can make me cling to losers and sell winners too soon. I should compare positions consistently rather than focus on whether each is above my average cost.","My account rose over these periods, but that does not show that my trades caused the gains or predict what comes next. I should make deliberate decisions without reacting to random price moves or checking frequency."]}
